reviewer_defects_carried_unrepaired.DEF-3: D-1 omits the R_real < 0.5 conjunct of the falsifier it claims fires.
reviewer_defects_carried_unrepaired.DEF-4_DEF-5: D-2 lacks the object-cost-parity measurement D-3 requires; object structure is confounded with factor-base selection policy. Cheapest discriminator named as RT047-CTRL-1 variant (b).
reviewer_defects_carried_unrepaired.DEF-6: The charged-unit proxy U has no written formula; harmless only because candidate definitions coincide when both arms reach 200.
reviewer_defects_carried_unrepaired.DEF-7: U is largely determined by fixed enumeration counts, so proxy agreement is not two independent confirmations; W is the discriminating limb.
reviewer_defects_carried_unrepaired.note: All six are minor and non-blocking per the reviewer; none is repaired in this task, because RC-21 permits no second amendment cycle. They bind the interpretation of the run and must be carried into TASK-20260801-009.
